name: uberasm-nerf-yoshi
title: Nerf Yoshi
description:
This Uberasm allows you to nerf Yoshi, by removing/restricting his various abilities, and/or by setting a timer that will destroy the Yoshi upon hitting zero. This makes it so that Yoshi's abilities/perks have a cost to them, and forces the player to use their Yoshi more strategically.

The Uberasm has a wide range of customizable effects, which both affect Yoshi's abilities, and the speed the timer decrements, should you choose to set it. Can be used on a per-level basis, or as Game Mode 14.

Uses 2 bytes of freeram as a main timer and a ticker timer.

See the included readme for detailed descriptions and usage of every effect/mechanic.

Please give credit if used.
